gateId.description: Identifier of the gate this technical report is being produced for (e.g. MCP-D03). This tool never decides the gate's outcome.

baselineRef.description: Passed through to hm_diff_summary. Defaults to HEAD.

testStatus.description: Caller-supplied outcome of any external test run for this gate (this MCP does not run product tests itself). Defaults to SKIPPED.

scope.description: Passed through to hm_scope_check's MCP-D03 hardened contract (minus gateId, which is set automatically).
